# Code of Conduct

MétaCan welcomes respectful participation. Keep technical disagreement focused on evidence, reproducible examples, accessibility, and maintainable solutions. Harassment, discriminatory behaviour, personal attacks, intimidation, publication of private information, and sustained disruption are unacceptable.

Report conduct concerns privately to <ahmad.pub@gmail.com>. Do not open a public issue for a conduct report.

This code of conduct is based on the Contributor Covenant, version 2.1: <https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/>.
